attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited published a newspaper advertisement on 16th November 2026 regarding the disclosure of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The announcement was made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The advertisement appeared in the Financial Express in English and Indore Samachar in Hindi. The financial results are available on the company website at www.highwayinfrastructure.in. The notice was issued by Palak Rathore, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 13, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited has disclosed the voting results for its first Extraordinary General Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The company reports that Resolution 1, an ordinary resolution to increase authorized share capital, was passed with 99.98 percent votes in favor. Resolution 2, a special resolution regarding the preferential allotment of convertible warrants to promoters, was also passed with 99.41 percent votes in favor. The total number of shareholders on the record date was 51,679. Voting was conducted via electronic means. The consolidated Scrutiniser's Report is attached to the disclosure. The results are reported as final in this filing.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board took on record the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Statutory Auditors issued a Limited Review Report on these results. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 6,080.02 million. Net profit for the half year was Rs. 107.92 million. Earnings per share for the half year was Rs. 2.53. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 stood at Rs. 4,125.74 million. Total equity was Rs. 2,396.08 million. The results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited held its first Extra Ordinary General Meeting for the fiscal year 2026-27 on 13th November 2026 via video conferencing. The meeting considered two resolutions. The first was an ordinary resolution to increase authorized share capital and alter the Memorandum of Association. The second was a special resolution to approve the issue and allotment of convertible warrants on a preferential basis to the promoter and promoter group. Voting was conducted through remote e-voting and during the meeting. Mr. Manish Maheshwari was appointed as the scrutinizer. The consolidated voting results are awaited pending the submission of the scrutinizer's report. The results will be declared upon receipt of the report and communicated to stock exchanges.
